description: React component for a contact form with validation, debounce, and optional server submission via fetch API.

methods.name: debounce
methods.description: Utility function to debounce calls, delaying execution by specified milliseconds.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates form data, checking for required fields and valid email format.

methods.name: postForm
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request to submit form data, with timeout and error handling.

methods.name: debouncedSubmit
methods.description: Debounced function to handle form submission, updating status and resetting form on success.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission event, validates data, prevents duplicate submissions, and triggers debounced submit.
